name: slinky
notes: Prebuilt Apple Silicon binary from the upstream GitHub release 0.6.0 (asset slinky-cli-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz; sha256 is of that archive). Mach-O arm64; `slinky-cli --version` reports 0.6.0. Smoke test generates a linker script from a two-segment YAML and checks sections, object mappings, fixed VRAM, stdout output and missing-input failure. Passed on 2026-10-16 with this binary.
